correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<p<1, geometric independent success gaps K have exact joint ray advance H=floor(K/2)+1 and tooth reward A=ceil(K/2); D=A-qH is centered with E D²=q/(1+q), E H=1/[p(1+q)], so renewal-reward variance rate pq. Independently summed exact geometric terms to K=299 at p=1/3,1/2,3/4, matching these constants to tiny tail errors. Tree edge first-passage identity H_m=m²+2 sum_{h=1}^m C_h follows from 2e+1 crossing times. Renewal-reward Donsker/time change and max-block O_P(log m) imply functional CLT; integrating gives 2sqrt(pq)∫B and t=1 variance 4pq/3; strong law gives 1+q. All results are tree-environment fluctuations of quenched MEAN, not walk path hitting distribution.
